recommendation: Keep the source fix. Let normal regeneration update any rendered diagrams or collateral rather than broadening this issue into manual generated-artifact edits.
issue_request: FHIR-23030 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for CareTeam.participant. The final decision changed CareTeam.participant.role from 0..* to 0..1 with a comment that multiple participant roles should be represented as multiple participants, and merged participant.period plus participant.timing into a single CareTeam.participant.coverage[x] choice of Period | Timing with cardinality 0..*.
initial_application: FHIR-20650 first added CareTeam.participant.timing as Timing 0..1. Commit 0ab189a35e212d2c6239ecae40a92696165d1ec7 then applied GF#23030 by changing role to 0..1, adding the multiple-roles comment, and replacing separate period/timing rows with CareTeam.participant.coverage[x] Period | Timing. That application left the merged choice at 0..1, and the generated/current StructureDefinition preserved that narrower cardinality.
additional_context: CareTeam is active/approved in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-44834 later renamed CareTeam.participant.coverage[x] to CareTeam.participant.effective[x] without changing cardinality, and an existing combined-branch audit commit already represents FHIR-44834. Current fhir.ini rename maps for period/coverage remain compatibility metadata. Generated-looking or QA collateral such as careteam.svg and the negative ctm-2 fixture still contain old coverage names, but they are not the authoritative definition for this fix. Searches found no Zulip or Confluence decision reversing FHIR-23030's 0..* cardinality.
reconciliation: Changed source/careteam/structuredefinition-CareTeam.xml so CareTeam.participant.effective[x], the current name of the FHIR-23030 merged Period | Timing choice, has max cardinality * instead of 1. The role cardinality/comment and later effective[x] rename were already correct.
